\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Odd Majority Influence]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p043-b004,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p046-b003,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p118-b007,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p119-b001
}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence}
\leanok
For a natural number $m$, define the odd majority influence to be the real number
$\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Odd majority influence formula]
\lean{FABL.booleanInfluence_majority_odd_eq_oddMajorityInfluence}
\label{FABL.booleanInfluence_majority_odd_eq_oddMajorityInfluence}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.booleanInfluence, FABL.booleanInfluence_majority_odd, FABL.majority, FABL.oddMajorityInfluence}
\difficulty{1}
For every nonnegative integer $m$ and every coordinate $i$ of the $(2m+1)$-dimensional
Boolean cube, the influence of coordinate $i$ for majority on that cube equals
$$\\frac{\\binom{2m}{m}}{2^{2m}}.$$
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Positivity of majority influence]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_pos}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_pos}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence}
\difficulty{3}
For every natural number $m$, $inom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$ is positive.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Odd majority influence recurrence]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_succ}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_succ}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence}
\difficulty{4}
For every integer $m\ge 0$, the quantities $I_j=\binom{2j}{j}/2^{2j}$ satisfy
$I_{m+1}=\dfrac{2m+1}{2m+2}I_m$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Strict decrease of odd majority influence]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_strictAnti}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_strictAnti}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence, FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_pos, FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_succ}
\difficulty{4}
For every pair of nonnegative integers $m<k$, the quantities $I_j=\binom{2j}{j}/2^{2j}$
satisfy $I_m>I_k$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Main term for odd majority influence]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{

}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain}
\leanok
For each natural number $m$, define the main term to be $\sqrt{2/(\pi(2m+1))}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Lower bound for majority influence]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain_le}

\leanok

\begin{theorem}[Odd majority influence bound]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_sq_le}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_sq_le}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence, FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_sq_mul_wallis}
\difficulty{4}
For every integer $m\ge 0$, define the odd-majority influence by
$I_m=\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$. Then $I_m^2\le \dfrac{2((2m+1)+1)}{\pi(2m+1)^2}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Odd majority influence approximation error]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceError}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p062-b012,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p118-b007,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p119-b001
}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceError}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddMajorityInfluence, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain}
For each natural number $m$, define the odd-majority influence error to be the
odd-majority influence at $m$ minus the main term of that influence at $m$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Bounds on the majority influence error]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceError_mem_Icc}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceError_mem_Icc}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceError, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain_le, FABL.oddMajorityInfluence_le_main_add}
\difficulty{3}
For every natural number $m$, the difference between $inom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$ and
$sqrt{2/(pi(2m+1))}$ lies between $0$ and $sqrt{2/(pi(2m+1))}/(2m+1)$, inclusive.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Negative Three Halves Power Identity]
\lean{FABL.oddArity_rpow_neg_three_halves}
\label{FABL.oddArity_rpow_neg_three_halves}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
For every natural number $m$, the real power of the odd integer $2m+1$ satisfies
$(2m+1)^{-3/2}=1/((2m+1)\sqrt{2m+1})$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Odd majority level-one weight error]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityLevelOneWeightError}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p062-b012,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p122-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p122-b002,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p123-b006
}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityLevelOneWeightError}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.BooleanFunction.toReal, FABL.fourierWeightAtLevel, FABL.majority}
For each $m\in\mathbb N$, define the odd-majority level-one weight error to be the
Fourier weight at level one of majority on $2m+1$ coordinates, regarded as a real
number, minus $2/\pi$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Level-one majority weight error bounds]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityLevelOneWeightError_mem_Icc}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityLevelOneWeightError_mem_Icc}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.fourierWeightAtLevel_one_majority_odd_le, FABL.oddMajorityLevelOneWeightError, FABL.two_div_pi_le_fourierWeightAtLevel_one_majority_odd}
\difficulty{4}
For every integer $m\ge 0$, consider majority on the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$,
taking the sign of the sum of the coordinates, with a zero sum assigned sign $+1$. Let
$W_1$ be the sum of the squares of its level-one Fourier coefficients, meaning the
coefficients indexed by singleton coordinate sets, and set $E_m=W_1-2/\pi$. Then $0\le
E_m\le \dfrac{2}{\pi(2m+1)}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Reciprocal power of an odd integer]
\lean{FABL.oddArity_rpow_neg_one}
\label{FABL.oddArity_rpow_neg_one}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
For every natural number $m$, the real power $(2m+1)^{-1}$ equals $1/(2m+1)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Total influence of odd majority]
\lean{FABL.totalInfluence_majority_odd_eq_mul_oddMajorityInfluence}
\label{FABL.totalInfluence_majority_odd_eq_mul_oddMajorityInfluence}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.BooleanFunction.toReal, FABL.majority, FABL.oddMajorityInfluence, FABL.totalInfluence, FABL.totalInfluence_majority_odd}
\difficulty{3}
For every integer $m\ge 0$, the total influence of majority on the $(2m+1)$-dimensional
Boolean cube is $(2m+1)\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Odd majority influence identity]
\lean{FABL.oddArity_mul_oddMajorityInfluenceMain}
\label{FABL.oddArity_mul_oddMajorityInfluenceMain}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain}
\difficulty{4}
For every natural number $m$, multiplying $\\sqrt{2/(\\pi(2m+1))}$ by $2m+1$ gives
$\\sqrt{2/\\pi}\\,\\sqrt{2m+1}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Odd majority total influence error]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p063-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p118-b007,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p119-b001
}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.BooleanFunction.toReal, FABL.majority, FABL.totalInfluence}
For each nonnegative integer $m$, define the odd-majority total influence error to be
the total influence of majority on $2m+1$ coordinates, viewed as a real number, minus
$\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sqrt{2m+1}$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Total influence error bounds]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError_mem_Icc}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError_mem_Icc}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddArity_mul_oddMajorityInfluenceMain, FABL.oddMajorityInfluence, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceError, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceError_mem_Icc, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain_le, FABL.oddMajorityInfluenceMain_le_inv_sqrt, FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError, FABL.totalInfluence_majority_odd_eq_mul_oddMajorityInfluence}
\difficulty{4}
For every integer $m\ge 0$, let $E_m$ be the total influence of majority on the sign
cube of dimension $2m+1$ minus $\sqrt{2/\pi}\sqrt{2m+1}$. Then $0\le E_m\le
\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2m+1}}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Negative half power of an odd integer]
\lean{FABL.oddArity_rpow_neg_one_half}
\label{FABL.oddArity_rpow_neg_one_half}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
For every natural number $m$, the real power $(2m+1)^{-1/2}$ equals $1/\\sqrt{2m+1}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Asymptotic total influence error]
\lean{FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError_isBigO}
\label{FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError_isBigO}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.oddArity_rpow_neg_one_half, FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError, FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError_mem_Icc}
\difficulty{3}
For each nonnegative integer $m$, let $E_m$ be the total influence of majority on the
sign cube of dimension $2m+1$ minus $\sqrt{2/\pi}\sqrt{2m+1}$. As $m\to\infty$, this
error is $O((2m+1)^{-1/2})$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Odd majority influence and error term]
\lean{FABL.totalInfluence_majority_odd_eq_main_add_error}
\label{FABL.totalInfluence_majority_odd_eq_main_add_error}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.BooleanFunction.toReal, FABL.majority, FABL.oddMajorityTotalInfluenceError, FABL.totalInfluence}
\difficulty{1}
For every natural number $m$, the total influence of majority on $2m+1$ sign coordinates
equals $\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sqrt{2m+1}$ plus its error from this main term, namely the
total influence minus $\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sqrt{2m+1}$.
\end{theorem}
